text:
Aisha Malik: Hi everyone — Aisha here, joining Developer Experience (remote, EST). Quick checklist/help: MDM invite, laptop image (MacBook Air M2), access to dev org repos, and permissions to the internal CI runner. Also curious who covers mentor/buddy for first two weeks. Fun fact: I commute by bicycle and collect vintage bike lights.

Connor Liu: welcome Aisha! :tada: People Ops should've sent the Jamf invite. If not, ping me and I'll re-send. I'll also add you to the devex channel and the private repo list.

Priya Rao: hey Aisha 3 I'm your assigned buddy for the first month. Happy to do a 30-min intro today. For CI runner access, please DM me your GitHub handle and SSH pubkey. Example keygen: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "aisha@redwood.ai"`

Maya Torres: FYI hardware request was submitted this morning — expect a company image shipment in 48 hours. Also adding you to the "Onboarding 1:1" calendar.

InfraBot: Onboarding record created for Aisha Malik. Tasks: MDM invite, laptop shipment, add to devex-repos, grant CI runner access.

Liam O'Connor: welcome Aisha. If you need a baseline dev container, check `gitlab.com/redwood/devex/devcontainer-starter`. I can fork a copy for you. Also we have a "Bike & Coffee" slack thread on Thursdays if you want to join.

Aisha Malik: Thanks all! I just replied to Priya with my GH handle. One question: are there any standard labels or PR templates we should use on initial contributor PRs?

Priya Rao: yes — we use the `contrib-checklist` PR template. I'll link it in the onboarding doc. Also we'll walk through it in our intro call.

Connor Liu: welcome again — excited to have you. If you bring a vintage lamp to show off, we'll appreciate the aesthetics :bulb:

Aisha Malik: Looking forward to getting started and meeting everyone. Appreciate the quick help!
